d:
I competed at IISER Pune 2026- my first cubing competition in 11 years.
Coming back after more than a decade felt surreal. Truly a core memory. I’m so grateful to the cubing community for welcoming me back with open arms.
A special thank you to Aryan Chhabra for helping me prepare for this competition. Having you there made the experience even more meaningful.
If you told 14-year-old me that one day I’d be practicing and competing alongside a 9x national record holder, I wouldn’t have believed it.
Chase your dreams.
